scientific_integrity: Proof by exact hierarchical multiset reconstruction. Computational tests are corroborative only and cannot establish the theorem for unbounded cardinalities; no external validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite, nonempty, globally nested named equivalence structures with fixed finite unary signature; classification relative to this class. No result for arbitrary crossing relations or infinite levels. General h+1 rank sharpness not claimed. Independent historical priority check remains outstanding.
title: Bounded-depth counting reconstruction of finite nested equivalence hierarchies
